title: Common counit transpose of the two site/scalar direct-image composites
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $a:A\to B$ any homomorphism of discrete commutative rings. Work with constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] in the ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived module categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $C_Z^R=\nu_Z^*$ for $Z=X,Y$ and $R=A,B$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $l_R=f_{\mathrm{et},R}^*$, $r_R=Rf_{\mathrm{et},*,R}$, $p_R=f_{\mathrm{proet},R}^*$, and $s_R=Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*,R}$, with their canonical adjunctions $l_R\dashv r_R$ and $p_R\dashv s_R$ and counits $\varepsilon^e_R,\varepsilon^p_R$ [def-kun-projection-formula-map, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $T_Z^t=B_Z\otimes^L_{A_Z}-$ for $t=e,p$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $d_R:p_RC_Y^R\xrightarrow{\sim}C_X^Rl_R$ be the inverse-image square of [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison], let $c^e:l_BT_Y^e\xrightarrow{\sim}T_X^el_A$ be [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso], and let $c^p:p_BT_Y^p\xrightarrow{\sim}T_X^pp_A$ and $\delta_Z:T_Z^pC_Z^A\xrightarrow{\sim}C_Z^BT_Z^e$ be the canonical ringed tensor/pullback comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons].

Define $\beta^R:C_Y^Rr_R\to s_RC_X^R$ to be the mate of $d_R$ and $\gamma^e:T_Y^er_A\to r_BT_X^e$, $\gamma^p:T_Y^ps_A\to s_BT_X^p$ to be the mates of $c^e,c^p$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Thus the transpose of $\beta^R_L$ is $C_X^R(\varepsilon^e_{R,L})\circ d_{R,r_RL}$ and that of $\gamma^t_L$ is $T_X^t(\varepsilon^t_{A,L})\circ c^t_{Rf^t_{*,A}L}$.

For any $J\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ put $P=r_AJ$. Assume the following cube identity at $P$:
$$\delta_{X,l_AP}\circ T_X^p(d_{A,P})\circ c^p_{C_Y^AP}=C_X^B(c^e_P)\circ d_{B,T_Y^eP}\circ p_B(\delta_{Y,P}).$$
Define maps $U,V:T_Y^pC_Y^AP\to s_BC_X^BT_X^eJ$ by
$$U=s_B(\delta_{X,J})\circ\gamma^p_{C_X^AJ}\circ T_Y^p(\beta^A_J),\qquad V=\beta^B_{T_X^eJ}\circ C_Y^B(\gamma^e_J)\circ\delta_{Y,P}.$$
For any such map $q$, define its counit transpose by
$$q^\flat=\varepsilon^p_{B,C_X^BT_X^eJ}\circ p_B(q).$$
Then both transposes have the following specified common normal form:
$$U^\flat=V^\flat=C_X^B\bigl(T_X^e(\varepsilon^e_{A,J})\circ c^e_P\bigr)\circ d_{B,T_Y^eP}\circ p_B(\delta_{Y,P}).$$
These are $B$-linear morphisms $p_BT_Y^pC_Y^AP\to C_X^BT_X^eJ$. No boundedness, quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, flatness of $B$ over $A$, or invertibility of a direct-image mate is assumed.
